en: The postcard shows a street scene in a small European town with several people, including children, on a cobblestone street lined with two-story buildings featuring shuttered windows. In the background, there is a prominent villa or mansion on a hill surrounded by trees. The image is in black and white or sepia tone, and at the top, there is printed text in Slovenian language.
